summary: Review audio DSP across realtime deadline, numeric, and signal-graph lanes with exact findings, remediation, verification, and proof boundaries.
triggers: An audio callback or plugin path needs hard-realtime hazard review.
A filter, feedback, accumulator, or conversion path may have numeric instability.
An audio graph needs latency, rate, channel, gain, sidechain, or cycle analysis.
antiTriggers: Mix or master a track by taste.
Teach general DSP without reviewing an implementation.
Claim static review proves audible quality or every host/device.

provenance.note: Candidate source read in full and independently rewritten for the portable product; no candidate prose was copied.
Three-lane scope, effects, findings, and proof-boundary semantics informed the product entrypoint.
The comparison's retained lane separation and unresolved-evidence treatment were consulted; no candidate performance result is promoted.
